key_developments: Democrats are favored to gain control of the House, needing only 3 seats with approximately 50 competitive races remaining.
Nate Silver's forecast shows Democrats ahead in 9 of 12 competitive Senate races, including North Carolina, Georgia, and Minnesota.
Trump's unpopular policies and sinking approval ratings are energizing Democratic activism, though a blue wave may be more modest than 2018.
Economic headwinds including high gas prices, record diesel costs, and inflation are creating challenges for Republican candidates despite Trump's central role in campaigning.
Republicans held their first-ever midterm convention in Dallas, though attendance from key candidates was lower than expected.

senate.note: Democrat James Talarico leads by 4 points in AARP/Trump pollster survey, forcing Republicans to pour tens of millions into defense.
